notes.title: Accessibility Update 01! (New Capsule Art too!)
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

We're back with an exciting update to the demo here. Most notably, we added a few accessibility features! (more are coming in the full release, stay tuned)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45507835/61c90a0ce71326e78de339f7ea4a66734f5376da.gif[/img]
Firstly, custom death colors! Some players reported eye strain on levels which were heavily covered in red. Now, you can choose any color you want for the death areas. This was a playful way to achieve a better gameplay experience for some folks, while also having a little fun. This will help you keep things fresh as you grind to try and beat the demo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45507835/b489accc5d23d83341c75f938997a9a4d4686341.png[/img]
Second, [i]Tiny Hands Mode![/i] In short, some players literally could not reach the game controls. This mode will limit the distance between each input on any individual level. You're welcome, tiny-hands-havers!

Everything else:

[list]
[*] When returning to title screen, the intro animation has been shortened. Back into the gameplay faster!
[*] Huge update to the title screen!
[*] Added settings panel finally - allows you to access game volume, death area color, etc. Also available from the pause menu.
[*] Huge thanks to [url=https://www.indiana-jonas.com/]Indiana-Jonas[/url] for the brand new game box/capsule art! He's been added to the game info-credits page. Look at that beautiful art!
[*] AND (other various secret updates and bug fixes) ;)
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45507835/725cb431b514edd17b3a08390fe097ebda6ca0e5.png[/img]
Lots of other small things in the background. But that's all I will share for now. Lots of folks have been playing, but nobody has beaten it yet! You could be the first - do you have what it takes?

Don't forget to [url=https://discord.com/invite/q2MCv5xDKb]join the discord[/url]!

Happy suffering <3 - Niko

notes.title: Demo Updates!
notes.content:
Hi folks!

Many thanks to everyone who has been playing the demo so far. Ove r the last few days I have made several improvements. I'm here to share a quick list of some of the changes. Thankfully no new bugs have come up since my post ~2 days ago.

[list]
[*] Several QOL additions have been made to the title screen, including clearer ways to close out of menus and some tooltips for the top-right buttons. (Escape also closes the menus)
[*] I added a pause menu! I did not feel this was in the spirit of the game, but I've realized that a pause menu [i]absolutely is[/i] if implemented correctly. :) You can pause the game any time once you've entered the first level by pressing escape.
[*] The first level has been modified to fit the game a little better.
[/list]
After this, I will lower the frequency of these updates. I don't want to flood anyone's feeds with short updates, instead dropping more thorough (but less frequent) updates. [url=https://discord.com/invite/q2MCv5xDKb]Keep in touch more regularly by joining the discord.[/url]

PS: If you beat it, don't forget to let me know! Many have played, but I have not heard of anyone successfully beating it. You could be the first!

That's all for now - happy gaming! -Niko

notes.title: A Wicked Game Demo is live!
notes.content:
Earlier today the demo for A Wicked Game went live! I am so excited for you all to try out some of the early game levels and try to reach the end of the demo.

I did get to see quite a few folks trying out the game, and ideas for the remainder of the game are exploding! Lots of notes from today (on top of the pre-existing roadmap. There were also a few adjustments made based on some initial feedback. Some noteworthy inclusions:

[list]
[*] An unintended shortcut on one level was plugged up
[*] Three levels were made more difficult <3
[*] One level was made easier (I am so generous I know)
[*] A bug with the end of the demo was fixed! (huge)
[*] I increased the chance of one fun secret thing occurring!
[/list]
I will continue to be attentive to bugs and fixes as they come up! I am also of course working on the remaining work of the entire game and its secrets beyond the demo. If you want to keep up with things more closely and provide thoughts and feedback, [url=https://discord.com/invite/q2MCv5xDKb]don't forget to join the discord![/url] That is where I will post the most consistently about the game. Much to do.

Thanks for suffering! Don't forget to review the game when you're done!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45507835/9dffd8d413a8d0c0ba62832bcc2134e232823ee0.png[/img]
